reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but shares only predicates for daily skipping while each consumer implements the filtering.

duplication.why: Daily weekend and holiday exclusion is independently orchestrated in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and budget schedule counting.

placement.why: Holiday classification belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but occurrence exclusion and adjustment-window knowledge remain spread across server consumers.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested recurrence rules, range handler, supporting data, tests, and release note.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate multiple exclusion loops, optional frequency plumbing, and a holiday-dependent range margin instead of owning one occurrence-resolution abstraction.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and createScheduleList decide daily occurrence exclusion outside applyWeekendRule, which cannot represent a dropped occurrence.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily nonworking-day exclusion appears as findFirst filtering, an upcoming-date collection loop, a range-loop continue, and an isDropped callback guarding budget accumulation.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays, getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays, and daily-specific branching enters getNextDate, applyWeekendRule, and applyWeekendRuleToDay while four consumers retain exclusion logic.
